steps.en: Install the pack once into your coding agent
steps.zh: 一次性把技能包装进你的 coding agent

steps.en: Registers each skill so your agent can invoke it by name as a slash command
steps.zh: 把每个技能注册成可按名调用的斜杠命令

steps.en: Point a publication-quality workflow at your draft
steps.zh: 对初稿发起一条可发表质量的流程

steps.en: Runs the refined pipeline — analyze, translate, review, polish — honoring your glossary and audience flags
steps.zh: 执行精翻流水线——分析、翻译、审校、润色——尊重你的术语表与读者设定

steps.en: Chain the rest of the pack the same way — structure, then theme for WeChat
steps.zh: 用同一条路径接上其余技能——先排版，再转公众号主题

value.en: translate → format → publish becomes named, re-runnable commands instead of prompts you re-craft every time
value.zh: 翻译→排版→发布变成可按名重跑的命令，而不是每次重搓的 prompt
